item.title: Bulletin updated at 00:00 HKT 15/Aug/2024
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Under the influence of a broad trough of low pressure, there will be occasional showers and squally thunderstorms over the coast of southern China in the next couple of days. Showers will be heavy at times. The trough of low pressure is expected to linger over the region early to midweek next week. The weather will remain unsettled. With the subtropical ridge extending westwards, showers will ease off gradually over the coast of Guangdong in the latter part of next week. Besides, Tropical Cyclone Ampil will continue to intensify today and tomorrow, move across the seas south of Japan and edge closer to the vicinity of the eastern part of Honshu of Japan.
